parts.name: rgb-window
parts.basis: Native STEP component 275 is the small package between the two USB connectors. Its location agrees with the unchanged dimension-photo RGB silkscreen; the exact schematic connects LED2 to GPIO27. No component is relocated, stretched, or added.

limitations: All manufacturer solids and open surfaces are retained at their original millimetre scale. Only the documented rigid centering/rotation is applied.
CAD/photo colours are approximate display choices; no measured optical material or hardware fit validation is asserted.
Header-installed, IPEX-antenna and memory SKU variants retain independent product identities but this model shows the documented base PCB; their mechanical differences are not separately rendered.
USB geometry is retained from manufacturer CAD; no cable anchor or electrical connection is exposed without a verified pin-side orientation.
The RGB package location has not been independently correlated to a CAD solid, so the 3D mesh does not claim a calibrated LED window; actual GPIO27 output remains available in the runtime.

referencePhotos.views: Official front view with dimension annotations.

materialBasis: Original topology, explicit neutral PBR with photo-based PCB colour. Materials are not calibrated.

sourceSearch.result: Exact manufacturer C5 mechanical file located; no sibling-chip CAD substitution.

assemblyNotes: All STEP components preserved in millimetres; rigid transform only. No inferred enclosure, mechanical fit, or variant-specific antenna/header accuracy.

photoRegistration.basis: Rigid native CAD retained at millimetres. Original dimension photograph registered by its documented PCB X/Y extents; source pixels unchanged. Perspective and optical distortion are uncalibrated.

rgb-window.basis: RGB-marked package between the USB sockets on the exact official dimension photograph.
